description: This file defines API routes related to telemetry data in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoint definitions for ingesting telemetry items, retrieving the last telemetry entries, and listing available metric names. The file specifies dependency injection for a telemetry service and uses Pydantic models for request and response validation.

methods.name: int ingest(req: TelemetryIngestRequest, svc=Depends(get_telemetry_service))
methods.description: Handles ingestion of telemetry items, delegating to the telemetry service, and returns the count of ingested items.

methods.name: List[TelemetryItem] last(n: int = Query(1, description="Number of last items"), svc=Depends(get_telemetry_service))
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent telemetry items, as specified by the query parameter.

methods.name: List[str] metrics(svc=Depends(get_telemetry_service))
methods.description: Returns a list of available telemetry metric names from the telemetry service.

ctags.name: last
ctags.pattern: /^def last(n: int = Query(1, description="Number of last items"), svc=Depends(get_telemetry_servic/
ctags.signature: (n: int = Query(1, description="Number of last items"), svc=Depends(get_telemetry_service))
